verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents JMAP runtime discovery: an authenticated session object at api.fastmail.com/jmap/session that advertises capabilities, accounts and API URLs. Its full API specification is the prose IETF RFCs (8620, 8621, 9610). The evidence says this is 'not a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec file' and that 'no OpenAPI exists on fastmail.com', and probes of OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Runtime capability discovery and prose RFCs are adjacent features, not a downloadable machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
